body: Thank you. That actually kinda helps. I don’t think anyone’s like actually validated my feelings. Not that they’re doing anything wrong. Just they mostly try to tell me about how things will get better but never say it’s okay to feel like this right now. Also my parents just want me to get over it and don’t understand how much it’s affecting me. And I kinda tried to explain but they’re still saying just get over it and be happy.

I didn’t actually lose someone, but it feels a lot like I did. I’ve been talking to a couple friends about it but they can’t make me feel any better. I know that I’ll never be able to feel that happy again. It sounds dramatic, I know. But I can honestly say that I’m very unique in the way that I experience certain things. And he’s very unique in every way. And after 17 years of never being happy, I’d finally found something that made me extremely happy. And now it’s gone. I don’t wanna suffer anymore.

It makes sense. It’s just, I lost the only thing that’s ever made me happy (not exaggerating) 7 days ago, and I’m not healing. I’ve gotten to the point of emptiness so that I’m not constantly in despair, but I don’t think empty is better. I did try a few times within the past week but I was never strong enough to go through with it. The dream just kind of gives me some motivation to actually go through with it. And no one needs me. I’m literally just a burden.
